51573363.DESCRIPTION: Binding affinity to His-tagged wild type human STING C-terminal domain (149 to 379 residues) expressed in Escherichia coli BL21 (DE3) cells assessed as dissociation constant by ITC analysis

original_paragraph.Materials and Methods: Isothermal Titration Calorimetry Assay. MicroCal ITC200 was used to determine the binding affinity of tested compounds to STINGWT protein. The buffer solution (100 mM tris–HCl and 150 mM NaCl, pH 7.4) was prepared in advance for diluting compounds and protein to desired concentrations. After centrifuging the prepared solutions at 12,000 rpm, the supernatant was transferred into a sample cell, and then the solution of test compound was loaded into a syringe. The instrument parameters of interval (120 s), titration volume (2 μL), and speed (750 rpm) were set followed by running the titration with a total of 19 drops at 25 °C. The binding constant (Ka), enthalpy (H), and entropy (S) were available through the analysis of Origin software.
